text:
maria: Hey all 1 dropping the latest hero + bench snippet for the product launch blog. Need copy 👍 and a legal quick-pass. Draft below — please reply with tiny edits or :thumbsup:.

nate: can you attach the raw curves? PMs want the p95 numbers per workload to double-check.

maria: uploaded: https://tiny.redwood/throughput-bench (view-only). Topline suggestion: 'Up to 2.7x lower per-token cost and ~55% lower 95th-percentile latency vs our previous hosted baseline.'

lee: tiny wording nit: replace "lower per-token cost" -> "lower per-token inference cost" to be explicit.

maria: done. New hero line: "Up to 2.7x lower per-token inference cost and ~55% lower 95th-percentile latency vs our hosted baseline."

sara: webinar ops flag 1 — can we sync the demo so the claim maps to slide 4 where we show the hybrid cache? Proposed date Thu 4/7 at 9am PT.

maria: yep Thu 4/7 9am PT works. Requesting 300 seats + waitlist.

nate: noted. Reserving 300 seats and waitlist in HubSpot. HubSpot mapping below (pls don't change tags):

```json
{
  "utm_source": "product_launch",
  "utm_medium": "blog",
  "utm_campaign": "throughput_lab_q2",
  "hs_lead_status": "engaged_marketing",
  "tags": ["launch_q2_2026","throughput_lab"]
}
```

lee: legal-bot 1 can you run a quick scan for claim language? We linked methodology tab in the sheet and a public eval notebook.

legal-bot: Automated scan: flag on absolute phrasing. Recommend adding dataset/method footnote and linking the notebook. Suggested footer: "Benchmark methodology: internal A/B runs using representative workloads; see methodology tab for harness, datasets, warmup, and config; public eval notebook linked." Manual review required for the phrase "up to 2.7x" 1 legal ops will reply within 48h.

maria: adding suggested footer and notebook link. Draft blog blurb now: 

"Today wes launching Throughput Lab 1 a serving configuration that can deliver up to 2.7x lower per-token inference cost and ~55% lower 95th-percentile latency compared to our previous hosted baseline. Benchmark methodology: internal A/B runs on representative workloads; see methodology tab for test harness, datasets, warmup, and config. Register to join the live demo on Thu 4/7 at 9am PT and download the public benchmark notebook."

nate: PM check 1 LGTM, add a short line linking the demo repo.

maria: added demo repo link.

sara: webinar ops 1 calendar invite drafted, demo cluster reserved, Q&A block 15m. Whos on the panel?

maria: I'll moderate, nate runs the demo, lee handles technical Q&A.

legal-bot: Manual review pending for "up to 2.7x lower per-token inference cost". Legal ops: expect note in-thread within 48 hours.

maria: next steps: 1) legal quick-pass, 2) hero image finalization (motion gif or static?), 3) lock UTMs + registration form. Please ack.

nate: ack 1 locking UTMs now and confirming seat + waitlist by EOD.

lee: ack 1 prepping demo checklist and slides.

sara: ack 1 webinar room + recording setup in progress.

maria: thanks team 1 will hold publish until legal signs off, then push to the publishing queue. :white_check_mark:
